Shared file presentation and upload primitives used by otherwise supported note and profile flows remain in scope.

Data-only chart primitives and mixed screens that still consume implemented statistics or federation routes remain in scope.
The gallery listing, editor, post, and preview screens require the gallery and user gallery API contracts, none of which ActivityPub.MisskeyApi exposes.
Antenna creation, editing, listing, and deletion require the antennas API family plus user-group and user-list membership contracts that are absent from ActivityPub.MisskeyApi.
Clip listing, editing, deletion, and note membership require the clips API family that ActivityPub.MisskeyApi does not expose.
Channel browsing, following, and editing require the channels API family plus Drive file lookup, all absent from ActivityPub.MisskeyApi.
The user registry key/value editor requires the i/registry API family that ActivityPub.MisskeyApi does not expose.
The favorites page requires the i/favorites contract that ActivityPub.MisskeyApi does not expose.
